name: Kinsbaile
description: The place where Colfenor waits for Rhys and where Nath is killed and Colfenor burns.

description_citations.text: "Rhys". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ashling takes a messenger job from Colfenor, gains the Vendilion clique and Brigid Baeli as companions at Kinsbaile.
timeline.quote: Ashling had accepted a seemingly innocuous messenger job from the treefolk sage Colfenor

citation.text: "Ashling", section "Pilgrimage". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At the Festival of Tales Gilt-Leaf soldiers ambush the party; Ashling repels the arrows with fire.
timeline.quote: Ashling protected her new friends valiantly

citation.text: "Ashling", section "Pilgrimage". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gaddock Teeg assigns Brigid to accompany Ashling in finding the Gilt-Leaf elf Rhys.
timeline.quote: Brigid became embroiled in an increasingly complex adventure when Gaddock Teeg assigned her to accompany a flamekin messenger named Ashling on her mission to find a Gilt-Leaf elf named Rhys .

citation.text: "Brigid Baeli", section "An unexpected adventure". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Teeg orders Brigid to capture Rhys as a gift for the Gilt-Leaf commander Nath.
timeline.quote: Teeg ordered Brigid to capture Rhys and bring him back as a gift to Nath.

citation.text: "Brigid Baeli", section "An unexpected adventure". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Rhys kills Nath, ending the elvish threat, and Colfenor admits he ordered Brigid's attack to coincide with his rebirth.
timeline.quote: the elvish threat to Kinsbaile was negated when Rhys killed Taercenn Nath in hand-to-hand combat

citation.text: "Brigid Baeli", section "An unexpected adventure". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Filled with self-reproach, Brigid leaves Kinsbaile during the Festival of Tales to atone.
timeline.quote: Brigid wanted to atone for her actions and saw the opportunity to leave her life in Kinsbaile behind.

citation.text: "Brigid Baeli", section "A new legacy". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Teeg dies in flames as Colfenor combusts, though Ashling is saved.
timeline.quote: as he would eventually be set ablaze and die as Colfenor dramatically combusted by way of his own machinations.

citation.text: "Brigid Baeli", section "A new legacy". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Brigid works as a decoy to free Brion and Kiel from Gilt-Leaf hunters.
timeline.quote: She worked as a decoy to aid the liberation of Brion and Kiel from the Gilt-Leaf hunters that had captured them when they laid siege to Kinsbaile

citation.text: "Brigid Baeli", section "A new legacy". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: During the Festival of Tales they ambush Rhys in Kinsbaile; Rhys escapes and Gryffid is banished by Maralen's magic.
timeline.quote: was quickly banished from the battlefield by Maralen's magic.

citation.text: "Gryffid", section "Lorwyn". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Brion and Kiel gather stories for Rosheen's birthday and give Rhys a scroll to deliver.
timeline.quote: entrusting him with a scroll of accumulated stories to deliver to Rosheen

citation.text: "Rosheen Meanderer", section "The dream". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Colfenor declares Rhys his final pupil and asks him to plant his seed cone in the Murmuring Bosk.
timeline.quote: wishing for him to travel to the Murmuring Bosk and plant his seed cone there

citation.text: "Rhys", section "Siring the Sapling". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nath and Gryffid ambush the party at Kinsbaile and Nath challenges Rhys to a duel.
timeline.quote: Nath offered him a sword and challenged him to a duel

citation.text: "Rhys", section "The master and the mentor". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Rhys kills Nath by twisting his head by the horns until his neck snaps; the elves let him depart.
timeline.quote: Rhys grabbed Nath by his horns and twisted his head until his neck snapped

citation.text: "Rhys", section "The master and the mentor". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ashling is rekindled by a greater elemental and Colfenor burns to death as planned, promising to see Rhys again.
timeline.quote: the rekindling of Ashling by a greater elemental that she was seeking and the fiery demise of Colfenor

citation.text: "Rhys", section "The master and the mentor". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Alerted to a great coming event, Colfenor goes to Kinsbaile to set his plan in motion.
timeline.quote: set in motion a chain of events that would reshape the plane's destiny

citation.text: "Colfenor", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Colfenor meets Gaddock Teeg and retains Ashling to reach Rhys, while Oona's Vendilion clique spies on him.
timeline.quote: Colfenor tasked Ashling with reaching his former apprentice, Rhys.

citation.text: "Colfenor", section "Reunion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Colfenor and Rhys reunite in Kinsbaile, and Colfenor sends him to plant his seed cone at Murmuring Bosk.
timeline.quote: Colfenor tasked Rhys with traveling to Murmuring Bosk

citation.text: "Colfenor", section "Reunion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Colfenor learns Brigid was meant to capture Rhys and redirects her to abduct Ashling so as to end his own life.
timeline.quote: Colfenor covertly redirected Brigid to abduct Ashling instead.

citation.text: "Colfenor", section "Reunion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Rhys is trapped by his former tribesmen, fights and kills Taercenn Nath, and the siege of Kinsbaile is broken.
timeline.quote: Rhys emerged victorious, killing the ruthless Gilt-Leaf taercenn.

citation.text: "Colfenor", section "Reunion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Colfenor shares the stories of his long life at the Festival of Tales.
timeline.quote: The gathered kithkin put aside their worries and listened with rapt attention

citation.text: "Colfenor", section "Reunion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ashling is rekindled by a greater elemental and her fire engulfs Colfenor, who dies as the last yew despite Rhys's efforts.
timeline.quote: the last yew burned brightly to his death

citation.text: "Colfenor", section "Reunion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nath and Gryffid come to Kinsbaile to ambush Rhys, planning to annex it.
timeline.quote: Nath and Gryffid came to Kinsbaile in pursuit of Rhys

citation.text: "Nath", section "Assault on Kinsbaile". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nath challenges Rhys to a duel; Rhys flees, is wounded by the cuffhounds, and kills Nath in hand-to-hand combat, his glamer failing at death.
timeline.quote: Rhys emerged victorious when he gripped Nath's horns and twisted them

citation.text: "Nath", section "Assault on Kinsbaile". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gryffid finds Nath's body, sets up a funeral pyre, takes his silver sword and swears to kill Rhys.
timeline.quote: Gryffid set up a funeral pyre for Nath, took his silver sword

citation.text: "Nath", section "Assault on Kinsbaile". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Rhys raises Nath's broken horn and tells the hunters to keep Nath's true appearance from the Blessed Nation.
timeline.quote: Rhys, victorious on the field of battle, raised the taercenn's broken horn

citation.text: "Nath", section "Legacy". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Great Aurora transforms Lorwyn into Shadowmoor; features correspond but are changed, such as Kinsbaile becoming Kinscaer.
timeline.quote: Kinsbaile became Kinscaer.

citation.text: "The Savory Mailbag". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Sep 2008. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The Gilt-Leaf ambush Rhys and the giants, striking Brion and Kiel with moonglove-poisoned arrows.
timeline.quote: the group was ambushed during their talk by the Gilt-Leaf pursuit commando

citation.text: "Brion Stoutarm", section "Capture". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Oona kills the entire population of Kinscaer, which has since been repopulated.
timeline.quote: The entire population of its doun equivalent, Kinscaer , was killed by Oona .

citation.text: "Clachan", section "Known clachans". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nath's hunting packs attack the festival, shooting Brion and Kiel with poisoned arrows.
timeline.quote: they shot Brion Stoutarm and his brother Kiel full of arrows

citation.text: "Festival of Tales", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sygg carries Rhys's party away on the Wanderwine River.
timeline.quote: The latter were only saved by the quick actions of Sygg

citation.text: "Festival of Tales", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The elves subdue Gaddock Teeg and Colfenor sends a forged message to Brigid.
timeline.quote: Colfenor sent a forged message to Brigid Baeli

citation.text: "Festival of Tales", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Brigid fights Ashling in the Murmuring Bosk and lies to Rhys.
timeline.quote: the kithkin hero lied to Rhys that Ashling had gone mad

citation.text: "Festival of Tales", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Rhys duels Nath in the Kinswood and breaks his neck; both are revealed as eyeblights.
timeline.quote: Rhys proved the superior combatant and broke Nath's neck

citation.text: "Festival of Tales", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gryffid swears vengeance over Rhys.
timeline.quote: his former friend Gryffid swore vengeance over him

citation.text: "Festival of Tales", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: A greater elemental reignites Ashling, costing Colfenor and Teeg their lives.
timeline.quote: This came at the cost of both Colfenor's and Cenn Teeg's lives

citation.text: "Festival of Tales", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Brigid and Rhys join forces to rescue Ashling.
timeline.quote: Brigid and Rhys decided to join forces

citation.text: "Festival of Tales", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: During the Festival of Tales, Teeg hosts Colfenor, whose presence draws many others to Kinsbaile.
timeline.quote: He hosted the yew treefolk sage Colfenor

citation.text: "Gaddock Teeg", section "Political suicide". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Colfenor hires Ashling through Teeg to reunite him with Rhys.
timeline.quote: Through Teeg, Colfenor hired the flamekin messenger Ashling

citation.text: "Gaddock Teeg", section "Political suicide". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nath arrives and lays siege to Kinsbaile; Teeg welcomes him openly and Kinsbaile falls immediately.
timeline.quote: Kinsbaile fell immediately as Teeg welcomed Nath openly

citation.text: "Gaddock Teeg", section "Political suicide". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Rhys narrowly evades Nath by leaving the clachan on a task for Colfenor; Nath and Gryffid wait for his return and begin subjugating Kinsbaile.
timeline.quote: Rhys had unintentionally managed to narrowly evade Nath by leaving the clachan to perform a task given to him by Colfenor.

citation.text: "Gaddock Teeg", section "Political suicide". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Teeg orders Brigid to bring Rhys back subdued to win Nath's favor, but Colfenor alters the message so Brigid targets Ashling, foiling the plot.
timeline.quote: However, Colfenor modified the message bound for Brigid and had her target Ashling instead

citation.text: "Gaddock Teeg", section "Political suicide". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Rhys returns, fights his former tribesmen, kills Nath and drives the elves out of the clachan.
timeline.quote: In the end, he emerged victorious, killing Nath and threatening the rest of the elves out of the clachan.

citation.text: "Gaddock Teeg", section "Political suicide". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Teeg dies in the conflagration Colfenor causes by using Ashling's patron elemental to end his own life.
timeline.quote: Teeg perished in the conflagration caused by Colfenor

citation.text: "Gaddock Teeg", section "Political suicide". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After the Aurora, Donal Alloway becomes cenn of Kinsbaile, now called Kinscaer.
timeline.quote: After the Aurora, the position of the cenn of Kinsbaile

citation.text: "Gaddock Teeg", section "Legacy". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Gilt-Leaf occupy Kinsbaile waiting for the traitor Rhys, planning to punish the kithkin.
timeline.quote: occupied Kinsbaile and waited for the traitor

citation.text: "Kinsbaile", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Rhys kills Nath and the rest of the elves leave to pursue him, sparing Kinsbaile.
timeline.quote: Kinsbaile was spared the elvish wrath when Nath was killed by Rhys

citation.text: "Kinsbaile", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ashling's rekindling causes Colfenor to burn, damaging buildings.
timeline.quote: the rekindling of the flamekin Ashling caused Colfenor to burn

citation.text: "Kinsbaile", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kinsbaile is repopulated after its Shadowmoor counterpart's population is killed by Oona.
timeline.quote: Kinsbaile was repopulated after the entire population of its Shadowmoor counterpart was killed by Oona

citation.text: "Kinsbaile", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
